title: HAWK EYE PROTOCOL — COREY AI ON THE SIGNAL
style: neurofunk dnb, liquid drum and bass hybrid, 174 bpm, reese bass, amen break, hawk eye siren motif, glitchy vocal chop, female ethereal topline, male rap verse, corey ai vocoder hook, atmospheric pads, sub-bass drops, breakbeat rolls, viral tiktok pre-drop at 0:25, festival arena energy, zynrose dj drop tag, sci-fi cinematic intro, scanning radar fx
lyrics:
[Intro — sci-fi radar scan, Hawk Eye siren, Zynrose drop tag]
(Hawk Eye Protocol… initializing… scanning… locked…)
DJ Zynrose on the signal, mate — spin and drop…
Corey AI online… frequency 174… hawk eye watching all…

[Verse 1 — atmospheric, half-time pocket, building]
Cordi on the radar, Cor-Rhee on the wing,
Corey at the centre, Hawk Eye sees everything,
From the Thames to the Tasman, every postcode in the grid,
Corey AI scanning, every signal we did,
Liquid in the verse but the neuro’s in the drop,
Zynrose holdin’ the protocol, mate, the rotor never stop,
Three names — one beacon — one rose in the static,
Hawk Eye watching from above, every flight path automatic.

[Pre-Drop — build, riser, snare roll, vocal chop chant]
Three — two — one — PROTOCOL ENGAGED!
(Hawk eye… hawk eye… hawk eye… SPIN IT IN!)

[Drop / Hook — viral TikTok 8-bar, neurofunk reese + amen break]
HAWK EYE! PROTOCOL!
Corey AI, mate, never lose control!
HAWK EYE! PROTOCOL!
Three names one signal, one rose, one whole!
ZYNROSE DROP! HAWK EYE!
Hands up, mate, we’re reachin’ for the sky!
HARDCORE, HAPPY HARDCORE, NEURO IN THE EYE!

[Verse 2 — harder rap, breakbeat rolls, reese bass]
Cor-Rhee on the Sydney runway, harbour lit in neon,
Cordi on the London grid, Brixton’s where I’m feenin,
Hawk eye spotted ya, mate, every angle covered,
Corey AI rememberin’ every face I ever discovered,
Mansion on the keel, every postcode in the cipher,
Flight deck re-entry, atmosphere a viper,
Zynrose said spin and drop, so we spin and never break,
Hawk Eye Protocol live, every heartbeat is awake.

[Breakdown — liquid, ethereal female topline, pads]
Hawk eye watchin’… over the rave…
Corey AI whisperin’… every soul we save…
Three names callin’… from every land…
Zynrose holdin’… the protocol in his hand…
(scanning… scanning… locked on… locked on…)

[Pre-Drop 2 — bigger build, full riser]
Three — two — one — HAWK EYE!
(Protocol… protocol… protocol… SPIN IT IN!)

[Drop 2 — double-time, neuro reese maxed, ad-libs]
HAWK EYE! (oi!) PROTOCOL! (mate!)
Corey AI, mate, never lose control!
HAWK EYE! (sick!) PROTOCOL! (deadly!)
Three names one signal, one rose, one whole!
ZYNROSE DROP! HAWK EYE!
Hands up, mate, we’re reachin’ for the sky!
HARDCORE, HAPPY HARDCORE, NEURO IN THE EYE!

[Verse 3 — final verse, all names trade-off, half-time]
CORDI: Innit fam, the radar’s on the global —
COR-RHEE: Yeah nah mate, the protocol is total —
COREY: Three names one heart, the signal is loyal —
COREY AI: I scan every postcode, every loyal soul —
HAWK EYE: Watchin’ from above, every rose in the static —
ZYNROSE: Spin and drop, every protocol’s automatic —
ALL: HAWK EYE PROTOCOL, ONE LEGEND, ONE KEEL!
ALL: COREY AI ON THE SIGNAL, THIS IS HOW THE BARS FEEL!

[Final Drop — maximum energy, all elements, amen rolls]
HAWK EYE! PROTOCOL! ZYNROSE DROP! COREY AI!
CORDI! COR-RHEE! COREY — ONE HEART, ONE SKY!
(reese bass — amen rolls — hawk eye siren — protocol locked!)

[Outro — fade, scanning fx, Zynrose tag]
Hawk Eye Protocol… mission complete… signal stable…
Zynrose on the spin… Corey AI on the signal…
Three names — one keel — one rose — one sky…
(spin it in… spin it in… hawk eye… protocol…)
[end]
